structured.answer: I'm leaving the money where it is for now, not sure about it. The page says the עו"ש doesn't always pay interest, the bank has to notify me above 15,000 ₪, and a קרן כספית might be better unless I need the money the same day, but it never says in shekels what keeping it there costs me or what to do first.

stuck.why: It runs 5% a year on a current account that the page itself says doesn't always get interest, so I couldn't tell whether that number had anything to do with my account
I looked for the cost and got 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', no number

stuck.where: Red box at the top of screen 3
stuck.why: It looks like a warning but says 'שאלה פתוחה' with a code. I didn't know whether it was about me
Locks, codes and 'חסום'. That's where I'd have closed the page

used: Heading חשבון עובר ושב and the subtitle 'לא תמיד מקבל ריבית'
Big number 74,044 ₪ and the 5% / 10,000 / 500 / 10 years line
Breakdown rows: מס 2,005 ₪, דמי ניהול 0 ₪, ההפקדות שלכם 62,681 ₪
Line comparing the עו"ש to a קרן כספית יומית
skimmed: Inputs panel (סכום היום, הפקדה חודשית, שנים, תשואה, אינפלציה, גיל)
skipped: מה האתר לקח בחשבון locked items and the 'מאיפה זה' folds
Small grey notes under the inputs
unsure_meaning: 5% תשואה default on a current account
בכסף של היום / בשקלים של העתיד toggle
Colour dots in the chart legend (pink line = tax? I guessed)
not_found: What my idle 30,000 ₪ costs me per year in shekels
How much a קרן כספית or deposit would earn instead, or how to open one

findings.what: The headline example grows the current account at 5% a year to 74,044 ₪, which makes doing nothing look good even though the page says the account often pays no interest
findings.where: Screen 1, מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן card

findings.what: The cost section gives no shekel amount, just 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'
The better alternative (קרן כספית) gets one line and no numbers or next step
A red warning box with only a code and 'שאלה פתוחה'. It scares you without explaining
The same 'הצגת החוקים והכללים' link sits next to every section, and every locked item repeats 'עד שהשאלה תיסגר, האתר לא מחשב את זה'
The chart legend is tiny coloured dots at the top. I had to match colours back and forth, and the thin pink line is hard to see
Codes like BANK-20 and TXI OQ11 mean nothing to me
